name: Tondoon Botanic Gardens
note: Garden: council botanic gardens on Glenlyon Road south of the city, with free entry, walks, picnic areas and a playground.

name: East Shores Parklands
note: Park: waterfront parkland beside Gladstone's city centre, with harbour views, playgrounds and a water play park.

name: Auckland Point Lookout
note: Lookout: harbour viewpoint above East Shores over the harbour entrance and the Auckland Point wharves, reached by stairs.

name: Gladstone Marina and Spinnaker Park
note: Park: marina precinct on Bryan Jordan Drive with harbour views, a swimming beach and forest walks at Spinnaker Park; island ferries leave from the marina.

name: Millennium Esplanade
note: Beach: foreshore park and patrolled surf beach at Tannum Sands, south-east of Gladstone.

name: Canoe Point
note: Beach: Canoe Point beach and parklands at Tannum Sands, a foreshore stop beside the esplanade.

name: Bray Park
note: Park: riverside park at Boyne Island with a boat ramp, jetty and the start of the Turtleway path.

name: Stirling Park
note: Park: Boyne Island park with the Turtleway footbridge over the river.

name: TurtleWay
note: Cycleway: about 18 km path following the Boyne River between Tannum Sands and Boyne Island; pin halfway along the route.

name: Lake Awoonga
note: Lake: freshwater lake behind Awoonga Dam south of Gladstone, known for barramundi fishing, picnic areas, walking trails and lookouts.

name: Curtis Island National Park
note: National park: the large island across Gladstone Harbour, reached by ferry from the marina, with camping grounds on the island.

name: Heron Island
note: Island: coral cay in the Capricornia Cays National Park, reached by resort boat or helicopter; nesting turtles and seabirds.

name: Lady Musgrave Island
note: Island: coral cay on the southern Great Barrier Reef, reached by day boat from the Town of 1770.

name: Capricornia Cays National Park
note: National park: the southern reef cays, including Heron and Lady Musgrave islands, with visitor access by boat.

name: Great Keppel Island
note: Island: the largest of the Keppel Islands, a resort island off Yeppoon reached by ferry and the gateway to the reef islands.

name: Pumpkin Island
note: Island: one of the Keppel Islands off the Capricorn Coast, named by the regional tourism board alongside Great Keppel Island.

name: Great Keppel Island Seaway Trail
note: Walking trail: a track on Great Keppel Island listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Bald Rock Dive Site
note: Dive site: a reef dive site among the Keppel Islands, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Child Island Dive Site
note: Dive site: a dive site in the Keppel Islands group, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Egg Rock Dive Site
note: Dive site: a dive site in the Keppel Islands group, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Man and Wife Rocks Dive Site
note: Dive site: a dive site in the Keppel Islands group, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Rosslyn Bay Fish Market
note: Market: fish market at Rosslyn Bay harbour near Yeppoon, a seafood stop listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Emu Park Markets
note: Market: Emu Park's market, listed by the regional tourism board; its days and season are not confirmed.

name: Fig Tree Markets
note: Market: market in the Yeppoon and Capricorn Coast area, listed by the regional tourism board; schedule not confirmed.

name: Emu Park Art Gallery
note: Gallery: art gallery in Emu Park, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Coorooman Creek
note: Creek: fishing spot with a boat ramp and pontoon at Emu Park, named on the regional tourism page.

name: Stanage Bay
note: Coastal locality: remote bay on the Capricorn Coast north of Yeppoon, named by the regional tourism board for fishing and camping.

name: Theresa Creek Dam
note: Dam: freshwater reservoir near Rockhampton listed by the regional tourism board as a place to visit.

name: Marlborough
note: Locality: small township in the Capricorn Coast region, named by the regional tourism board.

name: Byfield Rainforest
note: Rainforest: ancient rainforest, palms and freshwater creeks just north of Yeppoon, with walks and creek swimming.

name: Capricorn Coast Scenic Walking Trails
note: Walking trails: coastal walks around Emu Park and Yeppoon, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Capricorn Way
note: Touring route: a drive from inland Queensland to the coast, listed by the regional tourism board; a route rather than one place.

name: Leichhardt Way
note: Touring route: a drive route through Rockhampton listed by the regional tourism board; a route rather than one place.

name: Mount Archer National Park
note: National park: bushland range above Rockhampton with walking tracks, home to the Nurim Circuit boardwalk.

name: Nurim Circuit Elevated Boardwalk
note: Boardwalk: elevated boardwalk circuit in Mount Archer National Park above Rockhampton.

name: Rockhampton Barra Trail
note: Fishing trail: a barramundi fishing trail through Rockhampton's waterways, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Rockhampton Delta Fishing Trail
note: Fishing trail: a fishing trail through the Fitzroy River delta near Rockhampton, listed by the regional tourism board.

name: Mount Morgan Historical Museum
note: Museum: local history museum in the former gold-mining town of Mount Morgan.

name: Mount Morgan Historical Railway Museum
note: Museum: railway museum in Mount Morgan, the former gold-mining town inland of Rockhampton.
